regressions: BOM and no-BOM UTF-8, LF and CRLF, multi-site selection and exact password separators

Lookalike or absent domain, wrong local username, invalid host and port
Oversized and control-containing password, empty or oversized file, invalid UTF-8
Relative path, source-worktree secret, junction ancestry and invalid site selector
Existing target mismatch, sentinel, source custody, publication ordering and recovery checks
